_note: Speciality definitions for the ICB pack (scripts/build_icb_pack.py --speciality <id>). market = BNF presentation-code prefixes (NHSBSA English Prescribing Dataset). genericWords = first words of presentation names that are substances or formulations, not brands, so they fall into 'other'. notBrands = first words that are a range number, a drainage bag or a maker's name rather than a product brand (also 'other'; added 20/11/2026 after the live test: '365', 'Independence', 'Eakin'). brandLabels = first words that are only part of the product name, shown whole ('Nurse' is 'Nurse It'). marketNote = printed beside every share so the denominator is plain. rtt = NHS England Referral to Treatment treatment function, or null where none matches (it then reads Not applicable, never a substitute). Definitions are ours and are printed in the tool.

dermatology.label: Dermatology emollients
dermatology.marketText: BNF 130201 (emollient preparations) plus appliance section 2122 (emollients), primary care items

respiratory.label: Respiratory inhalers and oral treatments
respiratory.marketText: BNF 0301 (bronchodilators), 0302 (corticosteroids, including combination inhalers) and 0303 (leukotriene receptor antagonists and phosphodiesterase type 4 inhibitors), primary care items

diabetes.label: Diabetes medicines and testing
diabetes.marketText: BNF 0601 (drugs used in diabetes, including insulins, antidiabetic drugs and blood glucose testing), primary care items

wound-care.label: Wound care dressings
wound-care.marketText: BNF-code section 2003 (wound management and other dressings, appliance list), primary care items
wound-care.otcText: National position (read at source, 20/11/2026): NHS England policy guidance, "Items which should not routinely be prescribed in primary care" (published 3 August 2023, last updated 19 August 2025), lists no wound dressings, dressing packs or other wound care products, so there is no national low-priority or over-the-counter recommendation for this market. Local wound care formularies set which brands are used; this ICB's formulary has not been read at source.
wound-care.hospitalEmpty: Secondary Care Medicines Data records what trust pharmacies issue, and no product carrying this brand's name is in it. Hospital use of dressings that reaches wards by other routes is not in any open dataset the Hub reads, so no hospital figure is shown.
wound-care.marketNote: The market is every primary care item in BNF-code section 2003, which includes sterile dressing packs (Dressit and Nurse It are two of the largest lines), wound drainage bags and other appliances as well as dressings. A brand's share is of that whole section, not of dressings alone.
